blocks: Ujjwal Priyank, an Engineering graduate, has secured All India Rank 10 in UPSC CSE 2025 in his 3rd attempt . He belongs to Bihar & his optional subject was Sociology.
About Ujjwal Priyank & his Preparation Journey
Born in 1999 in Patna, Bihar, Ujjwal Priyank’s interest in serving society began at a very young age after experiencing numerous challenges in Bihar.
He completed his Class X & XII in 2016 & 2018 respectively from Patna & pursued B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering in 2022.
After completing graduation, Ujjwal Priyank dedicated himself to preparing for the UPSC exam.
His 3rd attempt resulted in securing an All India Rank 10, becoming an inspiration to all aspirants from Bihar, who dream of becoming an IAS Officer.
